segments.name: Banking
products: multifamily and mixed-use residential real estate loans
segments.description: A New York State-chartered savings bank serving individuals and businesses in its New York and Massachusetts market areas with loans and deposits.
segments.evidence: Substantially most of the Company's operations occur through the bank and involve the delivery of loan and deposit products to customers.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns interest paid by borrowers on loans, and to a lesser extent on investment securities, plus deposit fees and service charges paid by customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank's revenues are derived primarily from interest on loans and, to a lesser extent, interest on investment securities and mortgage-backed securities.

changes.text: In 2024 the Bank completed the sale of the assets of its Harbor West Wealth Management Group investment advisory division and no longer generates investment advisory fees.
changes.evidence: In December 2023, the Bank entered into an agreement to sell all of the Bank's assets relating to Harbor West Wealth Management Group to a third party and the asset sale was completed in January 2024.
